BETA Close X Serco Group plc has purchased a total of 1,571,952 ordinary shares on August 17, 2026, for an average price of 264.91 pence per share, with the lowest price paid being 263.20 pence and the highest at 268.00 pence. On August 18, 2026, the company bought back 300,000 shares at an average price of 263.34 pence, ranging from 262.00 to 264.80 pence. On August 19, 2026, 310,000 shares were purchased at an average of 262.48 pence, between 261.40 and 263.60 pence. On August 20, 2026, another 310,000 shares were bought at an average of 258.00 pence, with prices from 257.20 to 259.20 pence. Finally, on August 21, 2026, 284,632 shares were acquired at an average of 258.65 pence, ranging from 255.40 to 260.40 pence. Following these transactions, Serco Group plc has 972,013,090 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares.
